verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Hummingbird has a Case API for creating or updating cases, list and fetch endpoints for data syncing, and a batch case import API. None of it mentions external identifiers, idempotency keys, or reconciling customer/CRM and case records against identifiers from another system. The developer docs are password-gated, so these generic sync APIs are related features rather than documented support for stable external-ID reconciliation.

support.subject: As a developer, I can reconcile customer and case records with stable external identifiers
